title: themes in the store, with journeys that belong to one or more of them

criteria.text: A theme is a record: a name, the PM's words for why it matters, and its journeys; no steps of its own
criteria.note: Not built [V]: no theme kind, record or verb on main; no PR cites F137. Filed #1498.

criteria.text: Many to many: a journey may belong to several themes, a theme holds several journeys
criteria.note: Not built [V]: no theme kind, record or verb on main; no PR cites F137. Filed #1499.

criteria.text: Up and down in one call: a theme returns its journeys, built state and open questions; a journey or concept returns its themes
criteria.note: Not built [V]: no theme kind, record or verb on main; no PR cites F137. Filed #1500.

criteria.text: A new idea finds its theme: the where-does-this-fit answer names the themes, or 'no theme yet'
